open_points.subject: A20 non-Linux installation check
open_points.text: Installing a release on a host whose kernel is not Linux's fails, and no instance of it starts
open_points.question: Which actor or module checks the target host's kernel, through what operation, and at what installation stage does it reject a non-Linux host?
options: The release installer performs an explicit kernel preflight before installing anything
The deployment/orchestration platform admits the release only to Linux nodes
The container runtime is relied on to fail when it tries to start the instance
open_points.default_guess: Make the release installer perform an explicit kernel preflight before installation and refuse before starting Registry.

witness.initial: A release has a Linux base image and CPython 3.12, and an owner attempts to install it on a host whose kernel is not Linux's.
events: The owner invokes the otherwise unspecified installation process.
The installation reaches the requirement that the non-Linux host must be rejected.
outcomes: An installer-owned preflight detects the kernel and refuses before installing or invoking the runtime.
No installer check exists; the deployment or container runtime is expected to reject the instance when start is attempted.
witness.observer: The owner sees a different failure stage, diagnostic and amount of installation work performed.
